action_or_input: The Institute Employee submits a request to create a new file with a mandatory initial comment.
expected_result: File creation is accepted and the file is persisted; no authorization error is raised.
preconditions: A valid Institute Employee account with an assigned FTS role exists and is authenticated.
purpose: Verify that an authorized Institute Employee (Faculty/Staff) can perform an operational file action (file creation).

action_or_input: The System Admin attempts to create a new operational file.
expected_result: The system blocks the action and returns an authorization error; no file is created.
preconditions: A System Admin account is authenticated; no Institute Employee role is assigned to this account.
purpose: Verify that a System Admin account cannot perform operational file-processing actions (e.g., file creation).

action_or_input: The employee switches to a different assigned role context via the Fusion dashboard.
expected_result: The file owner attribute on all previously created files remains unchanged; the ownership identity is identical before and after the role switch.
preconditions: An Institute Employee has created a file (file owner recorded). The employee has at least two assigned roles.
purpose: Verify that switching role context does not change the file owner attribute on files previously created.

action_or_input: The employee switches from role A to role B.
expected_result: All previously recorded audit log entries retain their original actor identity, timestamps, and content; no audit record is modified or removed.
preconditions: An Institute Employee has performed auditable actions (file creation, forward) under role A. The employee also holds role B.
purpose: Verify that switching role context does not alter previously recorded audit history entries.

action_or_input: Attempt to retrieve the file's content after circulation.
expected_result: All comments and attachments added during and after submission are present and unmodified in the file record.
preconditions: A file has been submitted and circulated; it contains at least one comment and one attachment added during circulation.
purpose: Verify that comments and attachments added to a circulated file are retained and not deleted.

action_or_input: Attempt to discard or delete the circulated file.
expected_result: The system rejects the delete/discard operation; the file remains persistent in FTS.
preconditions: A file has been submitted and circulated.
purpose: Verify that a circulated file cannot be deleted (e.g., via draft-discard or any deletion operation).

action_or_input: The employee submits the file creation form with the comment field left empty.
expected_result: The system blocks file creation and returns a validation error indicating the initial comment is required; no file record is created.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee is on the file creation form.
purpose: Verify that file creation is blocked when no initial comment is provided.

action_or_input: The employee submits the file creation form with a non-empty initial comment.
expected_result: The file is created and persisted; no validation error is raised.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee is on the file creation form.
purpose: Verify that file creation succeeds when an initial mandatory comment is provided.

action_or_input: The employee saves the file as a draft.
expected_result: The draft is saved successfully; no error is returned.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee has started creating a new file but has not yet submitted it.
purpose: Verify that saving a draft is permitted before submission.

action_or_input: The employee opens the draft and modifies its content (e.g., updates the comment).
expected_result: The draft is updated and saved with the new content; no error is returned.
preconditions: A draft file exists for the Institute Employee and has not been submitted.
purpose: Verify that editing a saved draft is permitted before submission.

action_or_input: The employee discards the draft.
expected_result: The draft is removed from FTS; no error is returned.
preconditions: A draft file exists for the Institute Employee and has not been submitted.
purpose: Verify that discarding a draft is permitted before submission.

action_or_input: Attempt to discard or delete the circulated file as if it were a draft.
expected_result: The system rejects the discard/delete operation; the file remains in FTS.
preconditions: A file has been submitted and circulated (is no longer in pre-submission state).
purpose: Verify that draft discard/deletion is blocked after the file has been circulated.

action_or_input: The employee submits the forward action with the comment field empty.
expected_result: The system blocks the forward action and returns a validation error; the file is not forwarded.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee holds a file in their Inbox and is authorized to forward it.
purpose: Verify that forwarding a file is blocked when no movement comment is supplied.

action_or_input: The employee submits the forward action with a non-empty movement comment and a valid recipient.
expected_result: The file is forwarded; a movement record is created with the comment and timestamp.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee holds a file in their Inbox and is authorized to forward it.
purpose: Verify that forwarding a file succeeds when a mandatory movement comment is provided.

action_or_input: The employee submits the return action with the comment field empty.
expected_result: The system blocks the return action and returns a validation error; the file is not returned.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee holds a file in their Inbox and is authorized to return it.
purpose: Verify that returning a file is blocked when no movement comment is supplied.

action_or_input: The employee submits the return action with a non-empty movement comment.
expected_result: The file is returned to the sender; a movement record is created with the comment and timestamp.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee holds a file in their Inbox and is authorized to return it.
purpose: Verify that returning a file succeeds when a mandatory movement comment is provided.

action_or_input: The employee selects the second Institute Employee as the recipient and provides a mandatory comment, then submits the forward.
expected_result: The forward succeeds; the file appears in the recipient's Inbox.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee holds a file and is permitted to forward it; a second valid Institute Employee user exists.
purpose: Verify that sending/forwarding a file to a valid Institute Employee is accepted.

action_or_input: The employee selects the System Admin account as the forward recipient and provides a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The system rejects the forward action; the file is not forwarded to the System Admin account.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee holds a file; a System Admin only account exists.
purpose: Verify that forwarding to a non-Institute-Employee (e.g., System Admin only account) is rejected.

action_or_input: Employee B performs a return action with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The file is returned to Employee A (the sender); the movement record identifies Employee A as the receiver of the return.
preconditions: Employee B received a file forwarded by Employee A; Employee B is authorized to return it.
purpose: Verify that a return action routes the file back to the sender of the received movement.

action_or_input: Retrieve the file's movement history after the forward action.
expected_result: The movement history contains a new entry with: sender identity, receiver identity, timestamp of the forward action, the movement comment, and any attachments added; the entry is appended in chronological order.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee successfully forwards a file with a comment to a recipient.
purpose: Verify that a successful forward event is appended to the file's chronological movement history with all required fields.

action_or_input: Retrieve the file's movement history after the return action.
expected_result: The movement history contains a new entry with: sender identity, receiver identity, timestamp of the return action, the movement comment, and any attachments added; the entry is appended in chronological order after all prior entries.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee successfully returns a file with a comment.
purpose: Verify that a successful return event is appended to the file's chronological movement history with all required fields.

action_or_input: Employee B opens the file from their Inbox.
expected_result: Employee B can view the file contents and full movement history without error.
preconditions: Employee A created and forwarded a file to Employee B; both are associated with the file.
purpose: Verify that an authorized user associated with a file can open and read its contents and history.

action_or_input: Employee C attempts to open or retrieve the file or its history via any FTS interface.
expected_result: The system denies access; file contents and history are not exposed to Employee C.
preconditions: A file exists that Employee C has no association with (not creator, not a recipient, not in movement chain).
purpose: Verify that a user not associated with a file cannot access it.

action_or_input: The associated authorized user attempts to open the archived file.
expected_result: The archived file is readable; full contents and movement history are accessible to the authorized user.
preconditions: The file owner has archived a completed file; an associated authorized user (e.g., prior recipient) exists.
purpose: Verify that an archived file remains readable to authorized associated users.

action_or_input: The employee attempts to forward the file.
expected_result: The system rejects the action with an authorization error; the file is not forwarded.
preconditions: An Institute Employee is authenticated with a role that does not include forward permissions for a particular file.
purpose: Verify that a user whose role does not permit a specific FTS action is blocked from performing it.

action_or_input: The employee forwards the file with a mandatory comment and a valid recipient.
expected_result: The action succeeds; the file is forwarded and the movement is recorded.
preconditions: An Institute Employee is authenticated with a role that permits forwarding and holds the file in their Inbox.
purpose: Verify that a user with the correct role and file association can perform an authorized FTS action.

action_or_input: Retrieve the audit log after file creation.
expected_result: An audit log entry exists for the file creation event, capturing actor identity, action type, and timestamp.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee creates a new file with a mandatory initial comment.
purpose: Verify that an audit record is created when a new file is created.

action_or_input: Retrieve the audit log after the forward action.
expected_result: An audit log entry for the forward event is appended after all prior entries; prior audit entries are unchanged.
preconditions: An authorized Institute Employee successfully forwards a file.
purpose: Verify that an audit record is appended when a file is forwarded.

action_or_input: Retrieve the audit log after the archival action.
expected_result: An audit log entry for the archival event is appended; prior entries are unchanged.
preconditions: The file owner archives a completed circulated file.
purpose: Verify that an audit record is appended when a file is archived.

action_or_input: Perform a second forward action on the file; then retrieve the audit log.
expected_result: The original audit records (creation, first forward) are intact and unmodified; only a new entry for the second forward is appended.
preconditions: A file has existing audit records (creation, one forward).
purpose: Verify that existing audit records are not rewritten or removed when new events occur.

action_or_input: The file owner requests archival of the file.
expected_result: The file is archived; its state changes to archived and it is no longer forwardable or modifiable.
preconditions: An Institute Employee is the owner of a circulated file.
purpose: Verify that the file owner can archive a completed circulated file.

action_or_input: Employee B attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: The system rejects the archival request with an authorization error; the file remains in its current state.
preconditions: Employee B is associated with a circulated file but is not the file owner.
purpose: Verify that a non-owner Institute Employee cannot archive a file.

action_or_input: An authorized associated user attempts to forward the archived file with a mandatory comment and recipient.
expected_result: The system rejects the forward action; the archived file cannot be forwarded.
preconditions: A file has been archived by its owner.
purpose: Verify that an archived file cannot be forwarded.

action_or_input: An authorized associated user attempts to add a comment or attachment to the archived file.
expected_result: The system rejects the modification; the archived file remains read-only.
preconditions: A file has been archived by its owner.
purpose: Verify that an archived file cannot be modified (e.g., comment added).

action_or_input: Inspect the notification events triggered after Employee A's forward action.
expected_result: A 'file received' notification event is triggered for Employee B by FTS.
preconditions: Employee A forwards a file to Employee B.
purpose: Verify that FTS triggers a notification event when a file is received by a user.

action_or_input: Inspect the notification events triggered after the archival action.
expected_result: A 'file archived' notification event is triggered by FTS.
preconditions: The file owner archives a completed circulated file.
purpose: Verify that FTS triggers a notification event when a file is archived.

action_or_input: The consuming module invokes the FTS API with a valid authorized user context to track a file.
expected_result: FTS processes the request under its own RBAC rules, creates an audit record for the action, and returns the response; no domain-specific consuming-module policy is applied by FTS.
preconditions: A consuming Fusion module is configured to invoke an FTS file-tracking API; a valid FTS-authorized user context is available.
purpose: Verify that when a consuming Fusion module invokes an FTS integration API, FTS enforces its own RBAC and audit rules.

action_or_input: The consuming module invokes the FTS API with an unauthorized user context.
expected_result: FTS rejects the API request with an authorization error; no file action is performed.
preconditions: A consuming Fusion module is configured to invoke an FTS API with a user context that lacks FTS authorization.
purpose: Verify that the FTS integration API rejects requests that do not satisfy FTS authorization rules.
